digest.component_or_area: test_transport - live Jira DC test harness
propositions: test_transport.py derives a rename target by replacing the final character with 'Z', causing a collision when the source key already ends in 'Z'
the collision rate is approximately 1 in 26 runs due to uniform random draw of the final letter
the setup assertion `new_project_key != jira_dc_project` correctly caught the collision rather than allowing a silent no-op rename
derivation must guarantee the target key cannot equal the source key for any valid harness-generated key and must satisfy Jira's project-key constraints (uppercase, length 2-10)
unit test parametrization over all 26 possible final letters (including explicit RBJDRDZ case) provides deterministic coverage superior to live-run attestation
